name: Sam Asghari
biography: Hesam "Sam" Asghari (born March 3, 1994) is an Iranian-born American model, actor, fitness model and fitness trainer. He has appeared on the television shows Black Monday, Hacks, The Family Business, and The Traitors, as well as in several music videos. Since 2020, Asghari has been the owner of Asghari Fitness, a website that offers personalized training programs. He was married to singer Britney Spears from 2022 to 2024.
